items.ti: 이것은 백악관 남쪽 잔디밭에 있는 새로운 헬기장 착륙장을 찍은 첫 번째 사진입니다! 그것은 검은색과 흰색의 색조로 조각된 화강암으로 웅장하게 만들어졌습니다. 그야말로 예술작품이고, 트럼프를 싫어하는 사람들도 “와, 정말 좋다!”라고 할 정도다. 일정보다 일찍, 예산에 맞춰 완성되었으며, 비용이 많이 들기는 했지만 미국에 선물이 되었습니다! 프로젝트의 일환으로 정문의 상태가 좋지 않은 아스팔트를 최고 등급의 4~5인치 두께의 백색 화강암으로 교체했습니다! 평방 인치당 35,000파운드의 강도와 "100만년, 게다가 석재에 대한 최고 등급을 받았습니다. 아름다운 것 외에도 본질적으로 파괴할 수 없습니다. 균열이나 훼손이 전혀 없습니다! 헬기장 경로는 수년 전 유지 관리 구역이었던 녹색 입구 문이 흰색 H로 변경된 정문으로 직접 이동합니다.
items.ti_en: This is the first picture taken of the new Heliport Landing Zone on the South Lawn of the White House! It is magnificently made of carved granite in shades of Black and White. It is truly a work of art and, even the Trump Haters are saying, “Wow, that’s really good!” It was completed ahead of schedule, under budget and, again, though expensive, was a Gift to America! As part of the Project, the poorly conditioned asphalt at the Main Entrance was replaced with Highest Grade, 4 and 5 inch thick, White Granite! At a strength of 35,000 pounds per square inch, and rated “1 Million Years, PLUS, the Highest Rating there is for stone, aside from being beautiful, it is essentially indestructible. There will be no cracks, or defacement, EVER! The Heliport path travels directly into the Main Entrance where the green entrance doors, from what was years ago a maintenance area, were changed to White House White with new, highest level hardware, locks, and hinges. It is an Honor, “in my spare time,” to bring back the Beauty and Magnificence of the White House, to levels it has never seen before, not even after its construction in 1792. Like our Nation, under the Dumocrats, was in decline, the White House was a badly maintained “dump.” Now, it is a Palace! President DONALD J. TRUMP
